Method of Attack: The package was found to be harvesting hashes of developer email addresses on machines it was installed on. This started after Moq's developer bundled his controversial SponsorLink dependency within the project without notice.
Attack Vector: SponsorLink package caused Moq to harvest SHA-256 hashes of developer email addresses from local Git configs, and upload these to SponsorLink's CDN.
Indicators of Compromise: Inclusion of closed-source SponsorLink package, Harvesting SHA-256 hashes of developer email addresses from local Git configs
